notes.title: Big Update Pack
notes.content:
[b]Good news![/b]

In our first big update pack, we brought everything you asked for:

- [b]A NEW MINESWEEPER ENGINE[/b]: Now the first click never brings a bomb (so the game decreases the dependence on luck and increases the logical resolution). * The mine may appear on the first click in the first game puzzle for tutorial purposes.

- [b]A NEW BALANCING FOR THE STAGES[/b] (70% of all game stages have a new balance, bringing more challenge and variation).

and also SOME FIXES:

- Fixed the presence of American troops in the final stage of the game (all troops were duly replaced by the Soviet army).

- Fixed the story timeline (The narrative has been modified to fit the real story).

and to celebrate:

To celebrate this update, [b]we will return with the same launch discount during the next Summer Sale 2021[/b]!

Enjoy and also purchase the [b][u]War Mines: WW1 game in a special promotional bundle[/u][/b]!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640100/War_Mines_WW1/
